decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [S01, S02, D-01-E, D02- C, D03-C, Design and Access statement, Fire Statement received 18 June 2025 
D02- E received 25/09/2025].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the [northeast] elevation of the outbuilding shall be obscure-glazed and non-opening below 1.7 metres above internal floor level. The windows shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than in accordance with the requirements of this condition. 
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' privacy

Condition : 5 - No additional windows or openings shall be formed in the [northeast and western] elevation of the development hereby permitted.
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' privacy.

Condition : 6 - The [detached single storey] outbuilding hereby permitted shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the house at the '58 Hartham Road, Isleworth, TW7 5ES' described at the top of this decision letter and for no other purpose (for example, it may not be used as a self-contained dwelling or contain a bedroom, bathroom, kitchen or other primary residential accommodation, nor may it be used for business purposes). 
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' living conditions and the character of the area.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, raised terrace decking (retrospective) with metal balustrades, sub-ground cellar and storage, and an outbuilding to the rear of the property
